test_island_isolation: test that workers are properly pinned to their assigned islands during parallel evolution
test_submit_iteration_island: test that _submit_iteration samples programs from the specified island correctly
test_migration_preserves_islands: test that migration between islands preserves island structure and creates migrant programs
test_island_distribution: test that evolution iterations are distributed across all islands in a batch
test_island_restoration: test that database current_island is restored after sampling from a different island
